notes: Freya is the first-person narrator, called Born-in-Fire (a moniker from ch6); Onehand/Axethief/Scorchedpalm/Charhand are her own joke nicknames (once each). Bare 'Jarl'/'jarl' is not aliased because it also names the draug jarl and other jarls; the goddess is spelled Freyja and does not match.
